verdict.rationale: First-party docs say you can connect external MCP tool servers to Devin CLI, giving the agent access to APIs, databases, issue trackers and other services. These MCP tools fall under the same permission system as built-in tools and can be exposed as slash commands. The usage guidelines also cover MCP integrations for cloud Devin with Datadog, Sentry, Figma, Notion, Stripe and others. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and configuration details such as supported transports and config format.
